The '''void drifter''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was extremely hard to catch, and was considered almost legendary. Rumors spread in Dantooinian cantinas that a void drifter could materialize in any body of water it chose across all of Dantooine. It is unknown if these rumors were true, however void drifters were an extremely rare sight, regardless.<ref name="Item" />
